implementation_milestones: Self-host a library subset, port a tool, compile frontend/middle-end, then stage-compare the compiler.
acceptance_criteria: Verify stage provenance with an independently produced seed. A stage compiler builds its successor; independent builds satisfy declared binary or normalized-IR equivalence.
correctness_tests: Verify stage provenance with an independently produced seed. Run conformance on every stage and compare checked artifacts across independent builds.
performance_tests: Measure bootstrap wall time, peak RAM and size per stage.
security_risks: Compromised bootstrap seeds and trusting-trust risks.
maintenance_requirements: Bootstrap team pins seeds and publishes reproducible independent verification.
compatibility_policy: Retain a documented stage-0 path and external ABI/LLVM compatibility where needed.
